literals.Проверить и восстановить системные файлы: Check and repair Windows system files?

Check and repair Windows system files?

1. DISM /RestoreHealth — repairs the component store, downloading healthy files via Windows Update if needed.
2. sfc /scannow — checks system files and replaces damaged ones.

This takes a while — usually 10–30 minutes, sometimes longer. You can use the computer, but it is better not to turn it off until the check finishes. It does not always help: if something outside the system files is damaged, the check will not fix it.
